title: EMA Trend Gate ETH-specific parameter optimization
objective: Modify ema_trend_gate WFA config to use ETH-specific expanded parameter ranges based on BNB success pattern (rsi_oversold [25,30,35], rsi_overbought [50-70], hold_bars [96-168])
hypothesis: Expanding parameter search beyond generic defaults will improve ETHUSDT OOS Sharpe from 0.489 to >1.0, following the pattern that boosted BNB from 0.432 to 1.275
strategy_rationale: BNB asset-specific tuning lesson shows 195% Sharpe improvement with expanded ranges. ETH baseline 0.489 is below BTC's 0.998. Apply same expanded search pattern to ETH.
dataset_requirements: Binance ETHUSDT 1h data with maximum available history (binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv has ~64k rows from ~2018)

historical_depth_requirement.justification: Liquid crypto with multi-year history available; prior ETH run used deep dataset

source_plan.selection_reason: Existing binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv in workspace/data/; prior run used same source

scope_selection_rationale: ETHUSDT is the natural followup to BTC baseline (0.998 Sharpe) and prior generic ETH run (0.489 Sharpe). Apply BNB-style expanded parameter tuning.

data_acquisition.reason: binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv already exists with ~64k rows of ETHUSDT 1h data

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA completes with valid OOS metrics

fallback_if_blocked: If WFA data path issue, use exact path: data/binance_ethusdt_1h_deep.csv relative to walk_forward_engine root
notes: Prior run failed by referencing non-existent ema_trend_gate_eth/wfa_config.yaml - use EXISTING ema_trend_gate/wfa_config.yaml and modify in place
BNB lesson: expanded parameter ranges (rsi_oversold [25,30,35], rsi_overbought [50-70], hold_bars [96-168]) boosted Sharpe 195%
ETH prior: 0.489 Sharpe with generic params; target >1.0 with expanded search
